title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid email, password and required details.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid email, password, and required user details.
Submit the registration form.
Verify the registration completes successfully and user receives confirmation.

title: User Registration with Existing Email
description: Verify registration fails when using an email already registered in the system.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Enter an email address that already exists in the database.
Fill other required details and submit the form.
Verify the registration fails with an appropriate error message about email uniqueness.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify existing users can login successfully using valid email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid registered email and password.
Click on login button.
Verify user is logged in and redirected to their dashboard.

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Verify login is denied when user inputs an incorrect password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid email but incorrect password.
Click login button.
Login should fail and an appropriate error message should be shown.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that access to admin-only resources is denied to regular users and allowed to admins.

steps.description: Login as a regular user.
Attempt to access admin-only API endpoints and admin dashboard.
Access should be denied with correct error messages or redirects.
Logout and login as admin user.
Access admin dashboard and admin-only endpoints.
Access should be permitted with full functionality.

title: User Fire Alert Submission with Image and GPS
description: Verify that users can submit manual fire alerts including image attachments and GPS location data.

steps.description: Login as a regular user and navigate to alert submission page.
Fill alert form with valid fire incident details, upload an image, and set GPS location.
Submit the alert.
Verify alert is created, saved in database, and appears in user's alert list.
Verify the uploaded image is correctly stored and displayed.

title: User Views Own Alerts
description: Verify users can view their own submitted fire alerts correctly.

steps.description: Login as a user with existing alerts.
Navigate to alerts page or dashboard alert list.
Verify that only the user's own alerts are shown with correct details.

title: Admin Views All Alerts
description: Verify that admin users can view all alerts submitted by any users.

steps.description: Login as an admin.
Navigate to admin alerts management page.
Verify all alerts from all users are visible with correct details.

title: Admin CRUD Operations on Forest Areas
description: Validate create, update, and delete operations on forest areas are functional for admins.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to forest area management page.
Create a new forest area with necessary details and assign a risk level.
Verify new area is saved and visible on the map with correct color coding.
Update the risk level and details of the created area.
Verify updates are saved and map color reflects new risk level.
Delete the created forest area.
Verify the area is removed from list and map.

title: Map Visualization Accuracy
description: Verify interactive maps display forest areas and fire alerts with accurate locations and correct risk color coding.

steps.description: Login as user and view map.
Verify all forest areas are shown with correct geographic locations.
Check color codes of each area correspond to their assigned risk levels (green, orange, red).
Click on a forest area.
Verify detailed information about the area is displayed correctly.
Verify fire alerts appear on map at correct GPS coordinates.

title: Admin Updates Weather Data per Area
description: Verify admins can update weather information for specific forest areas and changes reflect on dashboards.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to area weather update section.
Select an existing forest area and update weather parameters such as temperature and humidity.
Verify updates are saved to database.
Verify updated weather data is reflected on admin and user dashboards.

title: Fire Prediction System Toggle and Alert Generation
description: Verify admin can toggle fire prediction workflow and automatic alerts generate accordingly.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to fire prediction settings page.
Enable the fire prediction system.
Verify the system generates automatic fire alerts based on predictions.
Disable the fire prediction system.
Verify automatic alerts stop generating while manual alerts remain functional.

title: Notification Delivery for Alerts and Risk Changes
description: Verify that both users and admins receive real-time or scheduled notifications for fire alerts and risk level changes.

steps.description: Trigger a manual fire alert as a user or an automatic alert via prediction system.
Verify users and admins subscribed to the alert area receive notifications promptly.
Change the risk level of a forest area as admin.
Verify that notifications about risk level changes are delivered accordingly.

title: Data Analysis Page Accuracy
description: Verify data analysis tools display accurate charts and tables for humidity, temperature, risk levels and trends.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to data analysis page.
Verify historical data for weather and risk levels are correctly represented in charts.
Verify trends over time are calculated and displayed accurately.

title: Mobile App Core Functionality Testing
description: Verify mobile app allows login, dashboard viewing, fire alert submission with images and GPS, and map interaction correctly.

steps.description: Install and launch the mobile app.
Login with valid user credentials.
Verify successful login and dashboard loads with fire risk and weather data.
Navigate to map view and verify GPS-enabled location is shown.
Submit a fire alert including an image and current GPS coordinates.
Verify alert submission succeeds and alert is visible in user's alert list.

title: API Authentication and Authorization Enforcement
description: Verify all API endpoints enforce authentication and role-based authorization as per access definition.

steps.description: Attempt to access authenticated API endpoints without logging in.
Verify access is denied with appropriate error messages.
Login as regular user and attempt to access admin-only API endpoints.
Verify access is denied.
Login as admin and access all endpoints.
Verify access is granted and operations function correctly.

title: Logout Functionality
description: Verify that users can log out successfully and are prevented from accessing authenticated resources post logout.

steps.description: Login as a user.
Perform logout operation.
Verify user session is terminated and redirected to login page.
Attempt to access a protected resource after logout.
Verify access is denied and user is prompted to login again.

title: Invalid Fire Alert Submission Handling
description: Verify system handles invalid or incomplete manual fire alert submissions gracefully with relevant error messages.

steps.description: Login as user and navigate to alert submission.
Submit alert form missing mandatory fields such as GPS location or image.
Verify submission is rejected with clear validation error messages.

title: Map Interaction Responsiveness and Detail Display
description: Verify that clicking on map areas or alerts reveals detailed information promptly and UI remains responsive.

steps.description: Login as user and open map view.
Click multiple distinct forest areas and fire alerts on the map.
Verify detailed info panels pop up or are displayed for each selected item.
Verify the UI remains responsive with no lag or freezing on repeated interactions.

title: Scheduled Notifications Functionality
description: Verify scheduled notifications are sent as expected at predefined intervals to users and admins according to settings.

steps.description: Configure scheduled notification settings as admin.
Verify notifications are sent at the scheduled times to targeted users and admins.
Disable scheduled notifications.
Verify notifications cease as per the updated settings.
